text:
lina: Quick weekly health pulse for onboarding cohort B  noticed a noisy 5xx window during the large import job. dropping details and proposed mitigations.

diego: can you share the headline metrics?

lina: 24h snapshot: overall error-rate 2.9% (baseline ~0.3%), timeouts 1.1%, rate-limits 0.6%. Spike concentrated 11:40-12:05 UTC.

harpreet: which endpoints are producing the most failures?

lina: Top failing endpoints by failure count: 
- /v1/stream-create (proxy -> runtime): 38% of 5xx
- /v1/embeddings/async-batch: 20%
- /v1/infer (long-form): 17%
- /v1/validate/template: 11%
- /v1/rewrite: 6%

zach: Ops alert fired: autoscaler throttled new pods while garbage-collecting old kernels at 11:36. ops-bot shows scaling loop then OOMs.

ops-bot: [ALERT] pool:onboard-b-3 - scaling_error (11:36 UTC) - recent events: scale_down_failure, kernel_gc_start, kernel_gc_complete, scale_up_lag. Logs available at /internal/logs/2151234567.

diego: I grabbed a small sample of runtime logs for /v1/stream-create:
```
[11:41:03] 502 bad gateway - connection reset by peer - req=acct-7721-req-884
[11:41:04] 500 runtime panic: mismatch in kvcache shard mapping (shard 5)
[11:42:09] 504 upstream timeout waiting for kernel init - req=acct-7721-req-890
```

harpreet: Account 7721 was doing a bulk ingest with heavy parallelism + seq_len ~ 800. That probably exercised kernel GC + autoscaler edge-case.

lina: Also saw a burst of 429s on /v1/embeddings/async-batch but mostly transient; a single partner retried aggressively.

zach: Renewal risk: account 7721 will be in renewal review next month. This looks risky if they saw a failed import.

harpreet: Short-term remediation suggestions: 
- temporarily route account 7721 to a warmed pool with pinned kernel mapping (pool:onboard-warm-1)
- apply gateway cap: max_parallel_streams=8 and max_seq_len=600 for cohort B imports
- add conservative client-side retry with exponential backoff for 502/504s (and add jitter)
- increase autoscaler cooldown to avoid racing GC during mass onboards

diego: I'll open a config patch: gateway caps + route rule for acct 7721. ETA 8m.

lina: I'll notify the CS owner and ask the partner to throttle ingestion; include sample IDs.

harpreet: Sample request ids to attach: acct-7721-req-884, acct-7721-req-890, acct-7721-req-907, acct-7733-req-2001.

zach: Runbook (short):
1) push gateway caps for cohort B (max_seq_len=600, max_parallel_streams=8)
2) shift inbound routing for acct 7721 -> pool:onboard-warm-1 (pinned kernel)
3) increase autoscaler cooldown from 30s -> 180s for pool:onboard-* until imports finish
4) monitor 5xx rate and token burn for 1h

lina: Commands to route (ops):
```
# route account to warm pool
POST /internal/ops/route_account -d '{"account":"7721","dest_pool":"onboard-warm-1"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS'
```

ops-bot: config change applied: gateway caps for cohort B at 11:52 UTC. Routing change queued.

diego: Routing change completed at 11:56 UTC. Autoscaler cooldown increased at 11:58 UTC.

ops-bot: monitor: 5xx rate dropped to 0.7% at 12:10 UTC (from 2.9%). Token burn for cohort B returned to normal after routing.

zach: Action items: 
- lina: customer note + renewal owner ping (owner)
- diego: push gateway + routing (ops owner)
- harpreet: follow-up RCA with runtime (root cause: kernel GC + autoscaler race)

lina: I'll include cost impact: preliminary spike ~2.8x tokens during the 11:36-12:02 window. CS note will include sample IDs and mitigation steps.

harpreet: For the RCA, we should capture kernel GC timings and autoscaler events. I'll request profiler traces from runtime team.

zach: Good progress. We should re-evaluate bandwidth limits in onboarding docs to prevent aggressive parallel imports.

lina: Agreed. Next sync in 90m or sooner if any regression. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
